description: Proves a PMail onion service is reachable from the Tor network

judges.description: TRUE if evidence shows successful HTTP response from the .onion address via Tor proxy

gates.description: Evidence must be within freshness window

critical_rules: Must be tested via Tor SOCKS proxy, not local loopback
The exact .onion hostname must match the claim subject
Timeout or connection refused => UNKNOWN, not FALSE
DNS resolution failure => UNKNOWN (onion addresses have no DNS)
